eips.title: Builder Execution Requests
eips.summary: Discussed whether EIP-8282 caused the builder deposit redirection bug affecting Lido and similar systems.

moments.context: Justin Traglia explained that Lido noticed builder onboarding logic complications, and the deposit logic was not updated for EIP-8282, enabling a potential attack.
Justin said the issue happened because of EIP-8282 logic. Nico and Potuz debated whether 8282 caused it or if it was a pre-existing problem that 8282 was a missed opportunity to fix.

eips.title: Execution-Layer Reorg State Retention Window
eips.summary: Referenced as the source of the 8192 epoch figure for BAL retention window reduction in Hegota.

moments.context: Toni linked the 8192 epoch number to EIP-8252, noting it represents the time to restore finality if up to ~79% of stake goes offline.

eips.title: Quick Slots
eips.summary: Quick Slots was at the center of a governance debate about merging CFI'd EIPs into the main consensus-specs branch.

moments.context: Potuz raised concerns that quick slots was being merged into the Heze fork branch without broad consensus or proper ACD agreement, calling it a governance problem.
Matthew Keil argued quick slots lacks broad consensus and has knock-on effects for future fork work; merging it feels like sneaking it past the goalie. Lightclient agreed.
Nico clarified quick slots is not merged on the spec side. Justin Traglia confirmed it does not need to go into the next devnet and wanted it optional.
Maria Silva noted that quick slots is easy to undo by simply setting slot time back to 12 seconds, unlike other protocol changes.

eips.title: Disallow new 0x00 validators
eips.summary: Cited as an example of a spec PR merged too quickly without sufficient developer review.

moments.context: NC noted EIP-8365's spec PR was merged only two hours after opening, doubting everyone had a chance to review it.

eips.title: Network Upgrade Inclusion Stages
eips.summary: Referenced as the EIP defining network upgrade inclusion stages; participants urged reviewing it before Thursday's ACDE.

moments.context: Spencer said EIP-7723 does not properly define the CFI process and should be updated. Nixo referenced agreeing at Svalbard to create a priority list per 7723.
Dan dropped the link to EIP-7723 and assigned it as homework for everyone before Thursday's ACDE discussion on inclusion stages.
